crew.overview: With the help of a German bounty hunter, a freed slave sets out to rescue his wife from a brutal Mississippi plantation owner.
crew.title: Django Unchained

crew.overview: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.
crew.title: Avengers: Infinity War

crew.overview: Armed with the astonishing ability to shrink in scale but increase in strength, master thief Scott Lang must embrace his inner-hero and help his mentor, Doctor Hank Pym, protect the secret behind his spectacular Ant-Man suit from a new generation of towering threats. Against seemingly insurmountable obstacles, Pym and Lang must plan and pull off a heist that will save the world.
crew.title: Ant-Man

crew.original_title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)
crew.overview: Harley Quinn joins forces with a singer, an assassin and a police detective to help a young girl who had a hit placed on her after she stole a rare diamond from a crime lord.
crew.title: Birds of Prey (and the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn)

crew.overview: Following the events of Age of Ultron, the collective governments of the world pass an act designed to regulate all superhuman activity. This polarizes opinion amongst the Avengers, causing two factions to side with Iron Man or Captain America, which causes an epic battle between former allies.
crew.title: Captain America: Civil War

crew.overview: Light years from Earth, 26 years after being abducted, Peter Quill finds himself the prime target of a manhunt after discovering an orb wanted by Ronan the Accuser.
crew.title: Guardians of the Galaxy

crew.overview: Before Charles Xavier and Erik Lensherr took the names Professor X and Magneto, they were two young men discovering their powers for the first time. Before they were arch-enemies, they were closest of friends, working together with other mutants (some familiar, some new), to stop the greatest threat the world has ever known.
crew.title: X-Men: First Class

details.biography:
Greg Steele started working on visual effects at Rhythm & Hues in 2004. He has worked on films such as Django Unchained, X-Men: First Class, The Incredible Hulk, and Night at the Museum. In 2013, he joined Method Studios he served as a visual effects supervisor for films like Avengers: Infinity War, Ghost in the Shell, Captain America: Civil War, and Guardians of the Galaxy.

Since 2020, he served as a production visual effects supervisor on Birds of Prey (2020) before joining Marvel Studios as a visual effects supervisor, working on their Disney+ series, Hawkeye and Ironheart.
details.name: Greg Steele
